evidence_quotes: The entire report is a flat bullet list with no labeled sections whatsoever.
'Watch closely in the coming weeks: the Tobelo–Indonesia cluster...' — this is a single bullet that gestures at risk watch but is not a labeled section.
'No tsunami warnings were triggered across any of the 30 sample events...' — this touches on a caveat but is embedded in a bullet, not a labeled data-caveats section.
There is no opening paragraph or labeled 'Executive Summary' section.
There are no 'Recommended Actions' or 'Monitoring Actions' listed as a distinct section.
criticisms: No labeled Executive Summary section — the report opens directly into bullets with no top-line framing paragraph.
No labeled Key Signals section — observations are present in bullet form but are not organized under a section header.
No labeled Risk Watch / Next 7 Days section — the final bullet alludes to future concern but is not a structured monitoring-priority section.
No Data Caveats / Limitations section — the report never acknowledges that the digest is a sample, that detection thresholds may affect counts, or any other data quality caveat.
No Recommended Actions section — there are no specific, labeled next steps or monitoring actions for emergency coordinators to act on.
The entire report is a six-bullet flat list; none of the five required structural elements are signaled with headers or labels, making it non-compliant with the standard template.
